result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but one clear defect stands out: an untranslated localization key is shown as a section heading. There are also minor issues with the time badge overlapping the food image and with low-contrast secondary text.

issues.description: The section heading shows the raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of translated text such as 'Popular near you'. This is a missing translation and looks unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Add the missing string to the translation resources for this locale, and add a fallback to the default language so raw keys never appear in the UI.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' cards, the time pill (e.g. '15–25 min') sits over the bottom-left of the image and overlaps the edge of the plate in the Green Bowl Poké card. This looks cramped and inconsistent with the other cards.
issues.suggestion: Keep the image focal point clear of the badge, or use consistent padding and placement for badges.

issues.description: Secondary text is light gray on a white background (delivery fees, the 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' placeholder, inactive tab labels). Its contrast is low and it is hard to read. The white '−20%' and '€0 delivery' badge text is also small.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text colors to meet WCAG AA contrast of at least 4.5:1, and consider increasing the badge font size.
